name: compute the fill pattern before the numeric factorisation
mechanism: using only which entries are nonzero, simulate the factorisation on the graph to find every position that will become nonzero, allocate exactly that storage, and then run the numeric factorisation into the preallocated pattern with no dynamic growth

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Symbolic Cholesky decomposition' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: Efficient way of storing sparse matrix

fails_when: pivoting for stability changes the pattern and invalidates it
